question: Which aircraft has a greater wingspan, the North American P-51 Mustang or the Boeing 737-500?
gold_cypher: MATCH (n:AircraftModel {name: 'North American P-51 Mustang'}), (m0:AircraftModel {name: 'Boeing 737-500'}) RETURN CASE WHEN n.wingspan_metre > m0.wingspan_metre THEN n.name ELSE m0.name END AS answer
generated_cypher:
MATCH (m1:AircraftModel)
MATCH (m2:AircraftModel)
WHERE (m1.name = 'North American P-51 Mustang' OR 'North American P-51 Mustang' IN m1.aliases OR m1.name CONTAINS 'P-51 Mustang')
  AND (m2.name = 'Boeing 737-500' OR 'Boeing 737-500' IN m2.aliases OR m2.name CONTAINS '737-500')
RETURN m1.name AS aircraft1_name,
       m1.wingspan_metre AS aircraft1_wingspan_metre,
       m2.name AS aircraft2_name,
       m2.wingspan_metre AS aircraft2_wingspan_metre,
       CASE WHEN m1.wingspan_metre > m2.wingspan_metre 
            THEN m1.name 
            ELSE m2.name 
       END AS aircraft_with_greatest_wingspan
answer: The Boeing 737-500 has the greater wingspan, measuring 28.88 meters compared to the North American P-51 Mustang's 11.28 meters.
